waking_words.name: Waking words
waking_words.hint: Treat message as mentioned if any wake word appears

zh.name: 唤醒词
zh.hint: 如果消息中包含任一唤醒词，则视为被提及

zh.name: 接收未提及消息
zh.hint: 将未提及的消息作为上下文传入

receive_unmentioned_access.name: Unmentioned Message Sessions
receive_unmentioned_access.hint: Limit which sessions may supply unmentioned context when Receive Unmentioned Messages is enabled

zh.name: 接收未提及消息的会话权限
zh.hint: 启用接收未提及消息后，限制哪些会话可以提供未提及的上下文消息

permission_mode.name: Session Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: allow_list: only listed sessions. deny_list: all sessions except those listed. An empty deny list allows all sessions; an empty allow list allows none.

zh.name: 会话权限模式
zh.hint: allow_list：仅允许名单内会话；deny_list：排除名单内会话。空黑名单允许所有会话，空白名单不允许任何会话

session_list.name: Sessions
session_list.hint: Pick sessions or enter <adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>. The permission mode determines whether this is an allow list or a deny list.

zh.name: 会话名单
zh.hint: 选择会话或手动输入 <adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>；该名单是白名单还是黑名单由会话权限模式决定

max_unmentioned_messages.name: Max Unmentioned Messages
max_unmentioned_messages.hint: Max unmentioned messages to include in context buffer

zh.name: 最大未提及消息数
zh.hint: 上下文缓冲区中包含的最大未提及消息数

group_chat_prompt.name: Group Chat Prompt

group_proactive_chat.hint: Allow AI to send messages proactively in group chats, be sure to have receive_unmentioned enabled

zh.hint: 允许 AI 在群聊中主动发送消息，请确保已启用接收未提及消息

group_proactive_chat_access.name: Group Proactive Chat Sessions
group_proactive_chat_access.hint: Limit which groups may trigger proactive chat when Group Proactive Chat is enabled. The session must also be allowed to receive unmentioned messages.

zh.hint: 启用群聊主动发言后，限制哪些群聊可以触发主动发言；该会话还必须被允许接收未提及消息
